title: Meeting Architecture: The Border Is the Function
description: A 30-section brief with mathematical proof that boundaries are not the edge of a system — the boundary IS the system. Three independent substrates satisfy the axioms: a quartz crystal circuit (photographed oscilloscope evidence), observational density probes (4,503-row pulsar catalog), and the institutional record (76 names, 15 meetings, 41 events across 9 sectors). Includes the F operator, the torus FFT (254 lines, pure PyTorch, CUDA-native runnable proof of irrational winding on T² = S¹ × S¹), Fisher geodesic coupling, circuit schematics, and a 206-page Statement of Facts.
